monument_name: Nāmasaṅgīti Phalcā (orig. construction early 18th cent. CE)
description_en: This three-bayphalcāwas established in the early 18th century. It is located at Pinchẽ, to the north of an eleven-bayphalcāand to the west of a small temple. It contains statues of Sarasvatī and Nāmasaṅgīti. The Matsyendranātha Guṭhī regularly recites Nāmasaṅgīti at this site. Thephalcā'swoodwork is covered with brown enamel paint.
description_ne: तीनवटा कवल भएको अठारौँ शताब्दीमा बनेको पिन्छेँ टोलमा रहेको फल्चा एघारवटा कवल भएको फल्चाको उत्तरपट्टि र एउटा सानो मन्दिरको पश्चिमपट्टि रहेको छ । यस फल्चामा सरस्वती र नामसङ्गीतिका मूर्ति रहेका छन् । मत्स्येन्द्रनाथ गुठीको आयोजनामा यस फल्चामा नामसङ्गीति पाठ गर्ने गरिन्छ । फल्चाका काष्ठस्तम्भहरूमा कलेजी रङ्गको इनामेल लगाइएको छ ।
brick_type: dāci apā (conical veneer brick), mā apā (regular fired brick)
references: Sources and references Sources Inscriptions from NS 1132 (on the base of the statues of Nāmasaṅgīti and Sarasvatī)

historical_events.event_name: Installation of statues of Nāmasaṅgīti and Sarasvatī
historical_events.event_description: Statues of Nāmasaṅgīti and Sarasvatī were installed on the northern wall of Nāmasaṅgīti Phalcā, in memory of someone's late parents Mangala Lāl Maharjan and Aṣṭamāya Maharjan.

According to the inscription, Nāmasaṅgīti Phalcā was renovated as to its previous structure had been standing in ruins. Kisna (Kṛṣṇa) Bhāro, Gusiṃha Bhāro, Jevanarāja Bhāvo, Gusiṃha Bhāvo, Mālasiñ Bhāvo and Hākudeva Bhāvo jointly contributed to its renovation.

Nāmasaṅgīti Phalcā was repaired under the leadership of Laritasiñ (Lalit Singh) Bhāvo. Other individuals who contributed to the reparation efforts include Laritasiñ Bhāvo, Hākusiñ Bhāvo, Dhañdeva Bhāvo, Bhekhvā Bhāvo and Cikidhika Bhāvo.
The complete quarter of Pinchẽ was paved withteliabricks by locals such as Bhāvasiñ and Sundha, among others.
The Nāmasaṅgīti Phalcā was renovated by GTZ/UDLE.
